notes.title: Version 1.3.0.0 - Major Update
notes.notes:
We have made a major update to the game to fix many visual and non-visual bugs. We have also changed some information on the user interface as well as the game menu.
Find the patch notes on our website: [url=https://maybe-ange.com/legends-of-kailrate#patch-notes]Legends of Kailrate - Patch Notes[/url]

[h2][b]VERSION 1.3.0.0:[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Game Performance:[/b] Lumen and Nanite have been disabled.
[*] [b]Lobby:[/b] The lobby has been redesigned.
[*] [b]Optimization:[/b] Code optimization for smoother and faster data transmission.
[*] [b]Internal Settings:[/b] Review of some internal parameters to improve performance.
[*] [b]FPS Refresh Rate:[/b] Changed the FPS refresh rate from 0.2 seconds to 1 second.
[*] [b]Scoreboard:[/b] Reduced the size of the scoreboard at the end of a match.
[*] [b]Quest Display:[/b] Quest display is now limited to a maximum of 3.
[*] [b]Hide Action Key Display:[/b] Added the "Hide Action Key Display" option to hide in-game controls.
[*] [b]Security:[/b] Implemented a security feature: if a player goes above or through the map, they will be returned to the center of the map.
[*] [b]FPS Stability:[/b] Fixed FPS instability that caused erroneous values; values will no longer exceed the maximum limit set in the settings.
[*] [b]EXP Multiplier:[/b] Adjusted the EXP bar multiplier from 100x1.5 to 100x1.2, reducing from 50% to 20%.
[*] [b]EXP Bar:[/b] The EXP bar is now fixed at 5000 EXP. Unlike before, it is now possible to surpass level 16 (+20% per level up to 5000, the multiplier is then removed when this value is reached).
[*] [b]EXP Visibility:[/b] The EXP count is now displayed.
[*] [b]Life Visibility:[/b] Life points are now displayed.
[*] [b]Enemy Quests:[/b] Revision of EXP for enemy quests:
[/list]

[list]
[*] [b]Enemy Quests:[/b] Revision of EXP for enemy quests:
[*] Kill 15 Enemies: Changes from 1500 to 500 EXP.
[*] Kill 20 Enemies: Changes from 2500 to 700 EXP.
[*] Kill 30 Enemies: Changes from 3500 to 1200 EXP.
[*] New: Kill 50 Enemies > 1800 EXP.
[*] New: Kill 70 Enemies > 2500 EXP.
[*] Kill 100 Enemies: Changes from 6500 to 3200 EXP.
[/list]

[list]
[*] [b]Teleportation:[/b] Added player teleportation mobility.
[*] [b]Menu Buttons:[/b] Revised buttons in the menu.
[*] [b]Black Fade:[/b] Reduced the black fade in the lobby from 2 seconds to 1 second.
[*] [b]Credits Bug:[/b] The credits bug that played the music several times with the space bar has been fixed.
[*] [b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed a reoccurring issue in version 1.2.0.0 (spawn of enemies & bosses above the object at the center of the map with a 0.238% chance on 100).
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.2.0.0 - Major Update
notes.notes:
More information on the website: [url=https://maybe-ange.com/legends-of-kailrate.php#patch-notes]Legends of Kailrate - Patch Notes[/url]

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Complete Artistic Overhaul:[/b] A full revision of the visual style for a more immersive experience.
[*] [b]Terrain Changes:[/b] Modifications to the terrain to enhance both aesthetics and gameplay.
[*] [b]New Scenery Added:[/b] Enriched the environment with new visual elements.
[*] [b]Particle Effects:[/b] Added particle effects for increased dynamism and realism.
[*] [b]Minor Lighting Adjustments:[/b] Subtle lighting tweaks to improve the overall atmosphere.
[*] [b]Event Alert:[/b] Added a notification to inform players when a boss is approaching.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Score Recording Fix:[/b] Resolved an issue where scores reaching 1,000 were not being recorded due to a comma in the queries.
[*] [b]Graphics Adjustment:[/b] Optimized graphics for certain clients to resolve FPS drops and instability issues.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1.0.0 - Major Update
notes.notes:
We are excited to present Version 1.1.0.0 of our game, a major update that enhances both performance and playability. Here are the key highlights of this release:

More information on the website: [url=https://maybe-ange.com/legends-of-kailrate#patch-notes]Legends of Kailrate - Patch Notes[/url]

[list]
[*] [b]Keyboard Display:[/b] Fixed display issues for WASD/ZQSD keyboards.
[*] [b]QWERTY Combination:[/b] Resolved an issue that prevented access to the pause menu on WASD keyboards.
[*] [b]Optimization and FPS Display:[/b] Fixed FPS display issues and optimized in-game performance.
[*] [b]Music Transition Management:[/b] Fixed a bug that caused a music change when exiting the game’s audio zone.
[*] [b]User Interface Update:[/b] Enhanced the interface for a better user experience.
[*] [b]Graphics Settings Optimization:[/b] Adjustments made to improve graphical quality and performance.
[*] [b]Crash Resolution:[/b] Fixed crashes on low-performance PC configurations.
[*] [b]Boss EXP Rebalancing:[/b] Adjusted boss experience from 1,000/25,000 EXP to 5,200/10,000 EXP.
[*] [b]Spawn Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed an issue where a boss would spawn above an Unreal object in the center of the map (0.238% chance).
[*] [b]Credits Stabilization:[/b] Eliminated audio bugs in the credits.
[*] [b]Performance Improvement:[/b] Overall performance has been optimized, and FPS drops caused by enemy spawns have been corrected.
[*] [b]Update Reminder:[/b] Added an update reminder system.
[*] [b]Leaderboard:[/b] A leaderboard is now available online and in-game.
[*] [b]Real-Time Game Stats:[/b] Track kills and game sessions in real-time with stats on kills versus games played.
[/list]
